wish: someone should make an app that runs checklists, like pre-flight or surgical safety lists
spec:
Write named checklists, one step per line, with an optional response after '...' (Fuel ... ON).
Run one step at a time: the current step is shown large, tap Check or Skip to advance, Back to undo, Reset to start over; progress is saved on the device.
It does not ship with any checklists, sync between devices, or replace an official procedure.
